items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: there was a fellow by the name of Roy, he used to play with Sam Morgan... I don't know if that is his last name, but he was a wonderful little drummer.

ctx.x: Were there any other early drummers that you can remember when you were a boy?

Well, let's see, there was a, there was a fellow by the name of Roy, he used to play with Sam Morgan, Sam Morgan's band. I don't know if that is his last name, but he was a wonderful little drummer. His name was Roy, and he had one who used to play with Kid Rainey, his brother, his name was Rainey, but I never knew it was Joe Rainey. But when Joe Rainey was with his brother, he was another wonderful drummer.
It's not far from here, he's down on Jackson, he's a preacher now, works in the church. Yeah, Joe's the Witness.
